# Millennium Chambers

> Gurugram-based legal practice (325H, Sector 38, Gurugram, Haryana 122001) advising Indian founders and growing companies on corporate, commercial and regulatory law. Led by Advocate Varun Bhutani (Bar Council of Delhi, 2018). Website content is general information only, not legal advice or solicitation (Bar Council of India rules).

## Key pages

- [Advocate Varun Bhutani](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/varun-bhutani-advocate-gurugram): Varun Bhutani is an advocate (Bar Council of Delhi, 2018) and Independent Partner of Millennium Chambers, Gurugram, advising startups on corporate, DPDP, labour and fundraising law.
- [India's Labour Codes: A Startup Guide](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/labour-codes-startups-india-guide): What the four Labour Codes in force from 21 November 2025 mean for Indian startups: appointment letters, fixed-term gratuity, gig worker contributions, wages and a compliance checklist.
- [Startup Insights](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/startup-insights): Weekly roundup of Indian startup funding rounds, SEBI, RBI, MCA and CERT-In regulatory changes, with a practical founder takeaway from a Gurugram startup lawyer.
- [Practice Areas](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/startup-corporate-law-practice-areas-gurugram): Areas of practice at Millennium Chambers, Gurugram: startups and venture capital, commercial contracts, DPDP Act, Labour Codes, consumer protection, trademarks and real estate leasing.
- [Trademark Registration for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/trademark-registration-startups-india): How Indian startups register a trademark: searching, choosing classes, filing Form TM-A, examination replies, opposition and renewal, with a practical founder checklist.
- [ESOPs for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/esop-startups-india-legal-guide): ESOP law for Indian private companies: Section 62(1)(b) and Rule 12, vesting and exercise rules, DPIIT startup relaxations, taxation and a founder checklist.
- [DPDP Act Compliance for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/dpdp-act-compliance-startups-india): DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025 for Indian startups: phased deadlines up to 13 May 2027, consent and notice duties, user rights, penalties up to Rs 250 crore and a checklist.
- [Founders' Agreement for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/founders-agreement-startups-india): What Indian co-founders should agree in writing: equity split and vesting, roles, IP assignment, non-compete limits, exits and disputes, and making terms binding via the AoA.
- [Term Sheets for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/term-sheet-startups-india): The term sheet clauses Indian founders must understand: valuation and ESOP pool, liquidation preference, anti-dilution, board and consent rights, vesting and the Companies Act/FEMA steps.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/disclaimer): Bar Council of India disclaimer for the Millennium Chambers website: information only, no solicitation, no legal advice and no advocate-client relationship.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/privacy-policy): How Millennium Chambers collects, uses, stores and protects information shared through this website, and how to contact us about your data.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/terms-of-use): Terms governing use of the Millennium Chambers website, including permitted use, no professional engagement, liability and governing law.
